content.title: Chapter 62 - OFFENSES — Sec. 62-124. - By other than commercial establishment or employee.
content.summary:
It shall be unlawful for any person, except a person who is at the time of sale or
               offer of sale lawfully employed by or engaged in a bona fide commercial establishment,
               to sell or offer to sell to any person any substance releasing toxic vapors.
(Code 1981, § 21-59; Or…
